name: Komano Hinata
source:
A tall woman with a calm demeanor.

She has a secret that she can't tell anyone, and wants a baby of her own.

[Edited from [url=https://kumitate-tsunoryu.itch.io/can-i-call-you-mommy-till-i-become-your-baby]Itch.io[/url]]
